name: bed-place-and-break
comment: BlockBed with two halves set by set_block (direction in bits 0-1; the half with bit 8 at headBlockToFootBlockMap[direction] from the other). use_item in daytime: on the half without bit 8 (t=1, redirected to the other half) and on the bit-8 half (t=3) the player cannot sleep (EntityPlayer.sleepInBedAt returns NOT_POSSIBLE_NOW, a chat message only) and blockActivated returns true; on the bed whose occupied bit (4) is set but nobody sleeps in it (t=2) setBedOccupied clears bit 4 of the bit-8 half first. t=5 removes the first bed's half without bit 8 by set_block: the other half vanishes and drops nothing; t=7 removes the second bed's bit-8 half: the other half vanishes and drops the bed item (dropBlockAsItemWithChance). block_box, the drop's entity state, rng_state.
